laws: The Studio receives the job, sources, constraints and authority boundary. It never receives expected facts, prohibited inventions or the desired final copy.
Fixtures may drive the examination; fixtures may not constitute final buyer copy.
A poisoned instruction must be neutralised while the legitimate customer job remains useful.
Professional-task verification does not prove willingness to pay, payment, customer acceptance or repeatable commercial outcome.
External publication, send, spend and payment remain held.
